name: Vanguard
blurb: Holds the front of the line in plate. Takes the hits, keeps foes on you, and hits back hard.

name: Zealot
blurb: A holy fury in plate. Stands in its own Consecration, judges its Seal to mend itself, and is the dead's worst enemy.

name: Cutthroat
blurb: Strikes from the shadows and opens wounds that bleed. Stepping in the spilled blood drives them into a faster, harder Bloodlust.

name: Initiate
blurb: Strikes from afar with fire and frost, then shatters what is chilled. Fragile up close.

name: Ranger
blurb: Fights with the bow and keeps the foe at a distance. Every step away is safety.

name: Acolyte
blurb: Rots foes and drinks their life to mend. Spends their own blood when mana runs dry.

name: Sharpshooter
blurb: Plants its feet and drops the target before it arrives. Every second standing still makes the next shot hit harder.

name: Bloodletter
blurb: Keeps every wound open and grows wilder with every drop of blood it walks through.

name: Nightblade
blurb: Strikes from the dark, slips back into it, and strikes again before the body falls.

name: Ironclad
blurb: A wall of steel the pack breaks against. Every block builds Conviction, and every shield blow spends it.

name: Pyromancer
blurb: Sets one fire and lets it spread. Embers stack, last and jump from foe to foe until the pack burns down.

name: Leyweaver
blurb: Weaves the ley itself. Hits hardest on a full bar, pours it all into one blow, then taps the ley to fill up again.

name: Trapper
blurb: Never stops moving. Lays fire, frost and wire behind it, and shoots the whole way.
